scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web,desktop -c blue,green,magenta "bun run --filter @nuncio/server dev" "bun run --filter @nuncio/web dev" "NUNCIO_DESKTOP_DEV=1 bun run --filter @nuncio/desktop dev"
scripts.dev:web: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "bun run --filter @nuncio/server dev" "bun run --filter @nuncio/web dev"
scripts.build: bun run --filter @nuncio/server build && bun run --filter @nuncio/web build
scripts.test: bun run --filter @nuncio/server test && bun run --filter @nuncio/core test && bun run --filter @nuncio/mobile test
scripts.test:daily-driver: bun run --filter @nuncio/server test && bun run --filter @nuncio/server test:e2e && bun run --filter @nuncio/core test && bun run --filter @nuncio/web test
scripts.test:daily-driver:codex: bun run test:daily-driver && bun run --filter @nuncio/server test:integration:codex
scripts.lint: bun run --filter @nuncio/server lint && bun run --filter @nuncio/web lint && bun run --filter @nuncio/core lint && bun run --filter @nuncio/core typecheck && bun run --filter @nuncio/mobile lint && bun run --filter @nuncio/mobile typecheck
scripts.test:coverage: bun run --filter @nuncio/server test:coverage && bun run --filter @nuncio/web test:coverage
scripts.gate: bun run build && bun run lint && bun run test && bun run --filter @nuncio/web test && bun run test:scripts
scripts.gate:full: bun run gate && bun run --filter @nuncio/server test:e2e && bun run --filter @nuncio/web test && bun run test:smoke-ui
